set.body:
Problem (edcdfd5): layout measures text through TextMetrics (modules/core/.../PlotLayout.scala:9) with Java2DTextMetrics (AWT) or CanvasTextMetrics (JS). JavaFX measures with its own text layout only for text plates (JavaFxCanvasContext.measureText, JavaFxCanvasContext.scala:252; JavaFxRenderer.scala:628), and contexts that cannot measure fall back to TextMetrics.estimate (JavaFxRenderer.scala:937). There is no JavaFX-backed TextMetrics and no measurement of the extent of rotated text (rotation is drawn at Scene.scala:1484-1490). AWT and JavaFX widths can differ; this is not documented as a layout hazard.

General use: sizing rotated column headers and labels in a JavaFX host so layout matches what JavaFX draws. Consumer example: PLS Neuro model studio header height fitted to the longest rotated label, up to ~130 px (spec section 2.3), with pixel/layout parity gated against a reference.

Acceptance:
- A public TextMetrics backed by JavaFX, family/weight/size aware, within 1 px of drawn JavaFX ink.
- A function giving the axis-aligned extent of text at any rotation, consistent across Java2D, JavaFX and Canvas metrics.
- Docs state the AWT vs JavaFX width difference and which provider to use per backend.

Out of scope: SVG viewer font resolution.
Provenance: verified read-only 2026-10-08 for PLS Neuro review bd-01M4DMGP1QFSQX9Z5V91B4B12F.
set.title: [Intaglio][Text] JavaFX-backed TextMetrics and rotated text extents
